scope: Evidence-backed capability discovery, not a claim of complete tenant coverage or live authorization.

accessPaths.studio-web: Portal window inside the user's own ODC Studio (bridge v32 portal-session fetch, runtime/studio-portal.mjs): each screenservice runs as a same-origin call of the page, with its own cookies and CSRF token, which never reach the facade. The user signs in once with odc_portal_login (SSO/MFA included). Used whenever the Studio holds a session on the tenant.
accessPaths.vault: odc3 broker (runtime/odc3-context.mjs) signed in with the Portal account of the Windows vault entry SSAM/ODC3/<host>/Portal; password sign-in only, no SSO/MFA. Used with no ODC Studio open, or with auth:"portal-credential".

access.secrets: The database user and password live only in the Windows vault entry SSAM/ODC3/<host>/DB/<name> (private prompt). They reach the request as secretRefs: only on the studio-web path, where the bridge reads the entry inside the ODC Studio right before the page's call (a bridge without secretRefs refuses and nothing is sent). The vault path refuses test/create/save (STUDIO_REQUIRED): a secret value never enters the facade process.

capabilities.title: Full runtime trace and span hierarchy
limitations: Current Portal assets expose DataActionGetSpans in traces.TreeView_multipleRoots, discovered through traces.trace; this is an internal contract, not a documented public REST API.
Processing states, missing parents/roots, cycles and truncation must remain explicit. A TraceId or a log detail is not a full trace.
Authenticated tenant execution remains unverified until a schema-validated read; no span pagination or automatic broad crawling is assumed.

capabilities.title: Timers: schedule, executions, run now, pause and resume
capabilities.keywords: timers timer agendamento schedule rodar executar run pausar pause suspender resume retomar
limitations: The schedule is part of the app configuration (asset-configurations timers[], odc_configurations set); which timer keys exist is known only after a read.
Executions are traces whose entry span is a Timer (monitoring.traces with span types Timer).

Run now, pause and resume have no captured Portal route (the Studio opens the page apps/timer?appid=<app>&id=<timer>&stageid=<stage>): refused as PORTAL_ROUTE_UNMAPPED until the live proof captures them; the instruction comes with the refusal and with this capability.
